GameOrchestra.Settings.GraphCrossfade.Hi: Overlap between consecutive tracks inside a custom playback graph, in milliseconds. The outgoing track fades out while the next one starts, hiding the small unavoidable delay of starting a track. 0 disables it (butt-splice on the outgoing track’s natural end). Try 100 if you hear a gap between tracks that are cut to run together.

GameOrchestra.PlaylistTree.LayerTooltip: Playing as an additive layer over the active audio, for the current combatant's turn
GameOrchestra.PlaylistTree.PriorityHint: Higher priority wins when several sources apply. Leave blank to inherit the shown default.
GameOrchestra.TokenConfig.DuckHint: How loud everything else plays while this layer is active. 100% leaves the other music untouched. The level glides down and back up over the crossfade duration.
GameOrchestra.TokenConfig.ExclusiveHint: By default this music plays as an extra layer over whatever is already playing, for this combatant's turn only. Tick to have it replace the current music instead.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.PlaylistConfi: Design a scripted sequence, weighted random selection, parallel layers, and game-state-driven transitions for this playlist as a node graph.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Title: Playback Graph
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Hint: Build a node graph to control how this playlist plays. Custom playlists always run in Soundboard (unsequenced) mode.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Tracks.DragHi: Drag a track onto the canvas to add it, or use +.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Tracks.Used: Used by {count} node(s) in this graph
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Tracks.AddNod: Add a Track node for this sound
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Drop.ForeignS: A Track node can only play a sound from this playlist. Drag the other playlist itself to add a Playlist node instead.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Drop.Unsuppor: Only playlists and playlist tracks can be dropped here.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Sou: A Track node's sound is set when the node is created. To play a different one, drag it in from the Tracks pane as a new node.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.NoS: This playlist has no audio tracks yet. Add sounds to it from the Playlists sidebar (drag files onto it, or use its own Add Sound button), then reselect this node.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Unt: This track loops seamlessly until the condition below becomes true, then exits at the point set by Boundary.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Pla: This node repeats a new pass of the referenced playlist forever and never advances - it has no exit.
Plays another playlist by its own rules. It moves on when that playlist finishes a full pass - a playlist that loops forever never finishes, so playback stays here until the music context changes.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.NoP: There are no other playlists in this world yet to reference.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Ran: Conditions are checked when playback reaches this node - not the instant game state changes. Each exit's weight controls how often it is chosen; cooldown is the minimum number of other picks before it can be chosen again.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Avo: Don't Route to the Same Node Twice in a Row
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Con: Conditions are checked when playback reaches this node - not the instant game state changes. The first matching exit, in order, is followed.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Def: Every Condition keeps this fallback exit as its last exit. It is followed when no condition above it matches, so playback always has somewhere to go - it can't be removed or changed.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Fix: A Random node always keeps at least one exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.For: Every exit plays at once. Connect each exit to a Track, Delay, or another node to build parallel layers.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.NoS: Select a node on the canvas to edit its settings.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Canvas.PanZoo: Right-drag empty canvas to pan · Left-drag to rect-select nodes, then drag any of them to move the whole selection · Ctrl+Scroll or the buttons above to zoom · Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V to copy/paste a selected node · Delete to remove the selection · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z to undo/redo
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Canvas.Cannot: The Start node can't be copied - a graph may only have one.
The Start node can't be deleted - a graph needs one to run.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Sh: Show this node on the canvas
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.No: The graph has no Start node.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Mu: The graph has more than one Start node; there must be exactly one.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.St: Start must have exactly one exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.In: An infinite Track loops forever and never advances, so it must have no exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Tr: Track must have exactly one exit.
Track loopCount must be at least 1.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Un: A Track looping until a condition must have exactly one exit.
This Track's loop-until condition is not set.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Lo: Minimum loops must be at least 1.
Maximum loops can't be less than minimum loops.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Tr: This Track's exit points back to itself. It will keep replaying, throttled to at most a few restarts per second - for a short track this means rapid, constant restarting. If you want continuous playback, enable Loop Forever instead (it loops seamlessly with no restart).
Track references a sound that no longer exists in this playlist.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.De: Delay must have exactly one exit.
Delay must have a valid range (max >= min >= 0).
This Delay's exit points back to itself with a 0-0s range, so it will tick repeatedly with no pause.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Fo: Fork must have at least 2 exits.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Ra: Random must have at least 1 exit.
A Random exit is missing a weight.
Every exit on this Random is weighted 0, so it picks uniformly at random instead of favoring any of them.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Co: Condition must have at least 1 exit.
A Condition exit is missing a condition.
A Condition exit matches a mood or phase but none is selected - that exit can never be taken.
Exit {index} repeats the condition of exit {first}. The first matching exit wins, so exit {index} can never be taken.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Un: This Track's loop-until condition matches a mood or phase but none is selected - the loop can never escape.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Co: A 'default' Condition exit must be the last exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.No: This node is not reachable from Start.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.In: These nodes form a loop with no Track or Delay in it, so a token would go round it without ever playing audio (and a Fork on the loop multiplies the tokens each lap). The wires are highlighted in red on the canvas: {path}
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Gr: This graph ends - playback will stop at End until the music context changes.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Pl: Playlist must have exactly one exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.In: An infinite Playlist node loops forever and never advances, so it must have no exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Validation.Pl: Playlist passes must be at least 1.
Playlist has no valid reference configured.
Playlist has no target playlist selected.
Playlist references a playlist that no longer exists.
A Playlist node cannot reference the playlist it belongs to.
Playlist reference is missing a valid section or mood setting.
The referenced playlist is a Soundboard with no play order of its own - it will be played in list order.
The referenced playlist has no custom graph and no sounds - it will play nothing.
This mood/phase is not in its configured list.
This reference leads back (through other Playlist nodes) to the playlist being edited, so it will be refused at runtime and skipped over.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.ValidationFai: The graph has validation errors; see the inspector panel for details.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.SaveFailed: Failed to save the custom playback graph.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Removed: Custom playback removed; this playlist has reverted to native behavior.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.RemoveConfirm: This will permanently delete the custom playback graph for this playlist and revert it to native shuffle/sequential behavior. This cannot be undone.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Inspector.Inf: This track loops forever and never advances - it has no exit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Hint: Replace the canvas with a ready-made graph you can then edit.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Confir: Applying a preset deletes every node and connection currently on the canvas. Nothing is written to the playlist until you press Save, but any unsaved work here will be lost.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Applie: Preset applied. Review the graph, then press Save.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Desc.S: Plays every track in order, then starts over from the first. A one-track playlist becomes a single seamlessly-looping track.
Plays every track in order once and then stops, staying silent until the music context changes.
Picks a random track each time, never the same one twice in a row, forever.
Shuffle, with a 2-6 second silence between tracks. Adjust each Delay node to change the gap.
Loops the first track seamlessly and forever. Pick a different sound on the Track node to change it.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Desc.L: Plays every track at once as parallel layers, each looping forever. Remove Fork exits to drop layers.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Desc.C: Alternates between an out-of-combat track and a combat track, re-checking which to play every time a track finishes (not the instant combat starts).
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.Preset.Desc.L: Loops one track seamlessly for as long as combat is active, then stops at a clean loop boundary - not mid-loop - the moment combat ends.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.UnsequencedOn: Available only on Soundboard (unsequenced) playlists - custom playback needs a mode that never auto-advances or stops sounds by itself.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.ActivityUnava: Live playback highlighting is only shown on the GM driving playback.
GameOrchestra.CustomEditor.RunawayLoopSt: Game Orchestra: custom playback stopped itself - a runaway restart loop was detected (see console for details).
GameOrchestra.Mixer.Title: Mixer
GameOrchestra.Mixer.PlaylistConfigHint: Set every track's volume and fade, a master gain, a volume ceiling, and this playlist's crossfade — without opening each track in turn.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.NoTracks: This playlist has no tracks yet.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.ScopeSelection: {count} tracks selected — the controls below apply to them
GameOrchestra.Mixer.GainHint: Scales every track in this playlist without changing the levels you set on them. Use it to balance this playlist against the others.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.GroupVolumeHint: Moves the selected tracks together, keeping the balance between them. Hold Alt to set them all to one level instead.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.CeilingHint: No track in this playlist plays louder than this, whatever its own volume says.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.TrackFadeHint: This track's own fade, in milliseconds. Blank inherits the playlist's.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.FadeBreaksSeam: A fade on a playlist with a playback graph audibly breaks a gapless hand-off: Foundry fades each track in from silence and, for a track that plays once, back out before the file ends. Set it to 0 for seamless graphs.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.Solo: Solo (this client only, until the window closes)
GameOrchestra.Mixer.EffectiveHint: What this track actually plays at once the gain and ceiling apply.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.ClampedHint: The ceiling is holding this track down — raising its own volume changes nothing until you raise the ceiling.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.UsedBy: Played by {count} Track nodes in this playlist's graph. Click to show one.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.Unplaced: No Track node in this playlist's graph plays this sound.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.SaveFailed: Could not save that change to the playlist.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.BakeHint: Write the effective volumes onto the tracks themselves and reset the gain and ceiling. What you hear stays the same.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.BakeConfirm: Write each track's effective volume onto the track itself, then reset the gain and ceiling? What you hear will not change, but the levels you set on the individual tracks will be overwritten. Muted tracks keep their stored level.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.Column.UsedByHint: How many Track nodes in this playlist's graph play each sound.
GameOrchestra.Mixer.FadeBreaksSeamShort: This playlist's fade breaks its graph's gapless hand-offs. Set it to 0.
